title: Meet collections and documents
summary: A collection groups documents. Each document has an id and named fields, such as a book title and page count.

blocks.text: A collection groups documents. Each document has an id and named fields, such as a book title and page count.

Use the Firebase Emulator Suite with the demo-reading-club project and Firestore on port 8080. Install the firebase JavaScript SDK in a local browser project. Run each full snippet on a fresh page. Keep the sample rules local.
Read the code step by step

items: books names the collection, and moon-trip names a document within it.
The title and pages values are fields in that document; they are separate from its id.

blocks.text: This worked model describes the document at books/moon-trip. The wrapper is an explanation, not an SDK write command.
